notes: CEO - Creative Engineering Operations v1.0.1. Everything now lives in ONE window with CEO's own frame - no more separate windows for the Mixer, Channel Rack or Welcome; they open inside the app and close inside the app. New startup: your diamond CEO logo over the red flash, same bass drop. Six new looks in the theme picker - Jelly, Glass, Gold Stainless Steel, Silver Stainless Steel, Diamond, and CEO Office (black marble and gold, the new default). Plugins: add your own scan folders so plugins from your other programs show up in CEO, and plugin editors open inside the window too. The Cali video player is removed. Mac: universal build for Intel and Apple Silicon, macOS 10.15 and up.
